body:
Estimated end-of-life date, accurate to within three months: 05-2027
See [the support level definitions](https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/trace_collection/compatibility/python/#releases) for more information.

## v4.17.1

### Bug Fixes

- LLM Observability
  - Fixes an issue where LLM Observability spans were reported as their own parent, so that traces lost their structure. This could happen when LLM Observability was enabled with `DD_LLMOBS_ENABLED` and Remote Configuration was enabled.
- profiling
  - Fixes an issue where the stack profiler permanently fell back to a slower memory-copy method when the process forked during the first seconds after startup.
  - Fixes an issue where the stack profiler permanently fell back to a slower memory-copy method when `faulthandler` was enabled during the first seconds after startup.
  - Fixes an issue where child processes can hang after fork when profiling is enabled.
  - Fixes a segmentation fault that could occur when the process was close to its memory limit (for example `RLIMIT_AS`). Under that pressure, some stack frames may be missing from profiles instead of crashing the process.
